_note: Single source for the colour tokens. Run `node scripts/gen-colorsets.mjs` to write the asset catalog; AppTests/DesignTokenTests fails if they drift. Values come from the Quiet Feed design system canvas, Direction A (Sage Paper). Entries marked derived were not in the canvas and were chosen to match it and pass contrast.

surfaceMuted.use: Finished card, done for today (dark derived)

line.use: Hairlines, dividers, empty bar track when done

lineStrong.use: Outlined button and text field border (dark derived)

accent.use: Sage. Primary button, bar fill, switch

accentSoft.use: Sage tinted fill, bar track, chips (dark from the landing page)

onAccentSoft.use: Text on sage soft (dark from the landing page)

warn.use: Amber. Low time, post mode. Never red
